title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 160
paragraphs: So the Chians handed Pactyas over. After this, Mazares campaigned against all who had helped besiege Tabalos. He enslaved the people of Priene and overran the entire plain of the Maeander, giving it to his army to plunder. He did the same to Magnesia. Then he fell ill and died.
